name: Chiang Rai (Thailand)

colors.symbolism: the central panel — the colour of King Mangrai's birthday

description: Divided vertically blue, purple and blue (about 1:2:1), the purple centre bearing a white elephant above the province name.
history: Used as the official flag of Chiang Rai province by the provincial government (changwat). Most Thai provincial flags follow a common formula: the provincial seal (the same seal used on the provincial coat of arms) charged on a single-colour field. The designs are traditional and date back to the formation of modern provincial administration in Thailand.
